desc.zh: 分清受威胁格与墙边，冻结日初边界，逐夜模拟隔离与扩散。
desc.en: Separate threatened cells from wall edges, freeze day-start frontiers, and simulate quarantine and spread.

complexity: O((D+1)mn) time, D ≤ mn, hence O((mn)²) worst case; O(mn) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Threatened cells versus wall edges
concepts.description: Deduplicate healthy targets but count each boundary edge.

concepts.name: Frozen-frontier simulation
concepts.description: Compute all regions before quarantine and simultaneous one-layer spread.
